message: 2 cell(s); mean annual rain 447 mm (NASA POWER: 625 mm); NASA POWER afternoons differ from the stations by -2.1 degC on average (largest month -3.2): days above 40 degC 70 -> 31 a year; sanity passed
notes: Interpolated from stations, so it is ground truth at the stations and an estimate between them. One rain cell (27 km) or temperature cell (100 km) covers the whole pilot box, so it corrects the average level of the weather record, not field-to-field differences.
